brief.title: Discovery call — KYC onboarding workflow for BrightPath Lending app — 22 Jan 202
business_goals: We need an automated KYC flow that verifies identity documents the moment someone applies.
From the applicant's side, they should be able to upload a driver's license or passport, take a selfie, and get a decision in real time — ideally under 60 seconds for the straightforward cases.
The system needs to call the Persona API and take their verification result as the source of truth for identity match.
That check is non-negotiable — if there's a hit, the application must be frozen and routed to a compliance officer, never auto-approved.
constraints: That check is non-negotiable — if there's a hit, the application must be frozen and routed to a compliance officer, never auto-approved.
Last year's exam took our team almost three weeks because records were scattered across six different systems.
There's also a hard deadline — legal wants this live before our state lending license renewal on March 31st, since the regulator specifically asked about our onboarding controls.
open_questions: Which metric defines success for launch?
